label: Samsung SmartThings Station hub and wireless charger
description: SmartThings Station is a 15 W Qi wireless charger that doubles as a SmartThings hub with Matter support and built-in Thread, Zigbee and BLE 5.2 radios. It has no Ethernet and no PoE - the only network interface is dual-band 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac Wi-Fi in infrastructure mode at 2.4 or 5 GHz.
